exercises.title: A Workplace Reminder
exercises.script: Please label all shared equipment before placing it in the storage room. Unlabeled items may be moved to the temporary shelf, which will be cleared at the end of each month. If you are unsure where something belongs, ask the facilities team.
exercises.question: What should employees do?
exercises.explanation: The reminder asks employees to label shared equipment before storing it.

exercises.title: A Policy Condition
exercises.script: The committee is willing to approve the proposal, provided that the organizers submit a revised budget by Friday. Without that document, the application will remain on hold until the next meeting.
exercises.question: What must the organizers do for approval to proceed?
options: Submit a revised budget by Friday
Reduce the proposal to one page
exercises.explanation: Approval depends on submitting the revised budget by Friday.
